section_summary: This section concerns Japanese government and fisheries training vessels seeking permission to visit American controlled ports and waters, especially in Alaska and the Aleutian Islands, in 1936–1937. Most correspondence addresses the HAKUYO MARU’s proposed calls at St. Paul Island and Dutch Harbor and the HAKUHO MARU’s proposed seal migration study in the western Aleutians. Federal departments weigh port restrictions, navigation hazards, the 1911 Fur Seals Treaty, and the diplomatic consequences of refusing visits.

people.name: Cordell Hull
people.role: Secretary of State; signed some documents as Acting Secretary

people.name: Jiro Niino
people.role: Japanese Agriculture and Forestry engineer commanding the HAKUHO MARU

people.name: D. J. Shaughnessy
people.role: Acting Commissioner of Immigration and Naturalization

subfiles.title: Thanks for treatment of the SHIROTAKA MARU
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew, American Embassy, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Transmits the Fishery Institute’s thanks for courtesies shown its training ship at American Pacific ports.
subfiles.summary: Grew forwards a translated letter and connects the visit to a consular report about Japanese fishing off the northwest coast.

subfiles.title: Fishery Institute letter of thanks
subfiles.about: Thanks American authorities for assistance to the training ship during its Pacific cruise.
subfiles.summary: Sugiura reports the ship’s safe return to Tokyo Bay after visiting Kiska and other American ports.

subfiles.title: Proposed ITOBUKI MARU visit to Manila
subfiles.about: Requests permission and customary facilities for the ITOBUKI MARU to visit Manila.
subfiles.summary: The note identifies Captain Jiemon Kida, an eighteen member crew, and an expected early March arrival.

subfiles.title: ITOBUKI MARU notice to Navy
subfiles.about: Advises Navy of the proposed Manila visit and requests usual courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Confirms a telephone notification about the Japanese fisheries vessel.

subfiles.title: ITOBUKI MARU notice to War Department
subfiles.about: Seeks War Department concurrence in the proposed Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Confirms a telephone inquiry and notes that Navy has also been advised.

subfiles.title: Reply on ITOBUKI MARU’s Manila visit
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the requested Manila visit and promises customary facilities.
subfiles.summary: State says arrangements are underway and asks for the vessel’s exact arrival date.

subfiles.title: Navy concurrence on ITOBUKI MARU
subfiles.about: States that Navy has no objection to the Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Naval officials will be notified to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for ITOBUKI MARU
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to extend facilities to the vessel in Manila.
subfiles.summary: The Philippine Department was notified by radiogram; insular affairs officials were also informed.

subfiles.title: HAKUYO MARU proposed Alaskan itinerary
subfiles.about: Requests permission for the HAKUYO MARU to visit Bristol Bay, St. Paul Island, and Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador supplies June and July dates, Captain Jinzo Nakagawa’s command, and the numbers of crew and students.

subfiles.title: Navy consultation on HAKUYO MARU
subfiles.about: Requests Navy’s advice on the proposed Alaskan calls and port of entry restrictions.
subfiles.summary: State encloses the Japanese request and cites its October 1936 circular.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of HAKUYO MARU request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed cruise while federal departments consider it.
subfiles.summary: State promises a further reply after consulting interested departments.

subfiles.title: Agriculture notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The expected call is July 14–17.

subfiles.title: Commerce notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The expected call is July 14–17.

subfiles.title: Interior notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: Other interested departments received similar notices.

subfiles.title: Labor notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The note concerns the expected July visit.

subfiles.title: War notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: The expected call is July 14–17.

subfiles.title: Treasury notice of Dutch Harbor call
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for the HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: Other federal departments received similar notices.

subfiles.title: Navy asks why HAKUYO MARU seeks St. Paul
subfiles.about: Questions the proposed call at a harbor outside the listed ports of entry.
subfiles.summary: Navy asks for detailed reasons for the St. Paul visit before commenting on the cruise.

subfiles.title: Request for reasons for St. Paul visit
subfiles.about: Asks Japan to explain the proposed HAKUYO MARU visit to St. Paul Island.
subfiles.summary: State cites its circular governing foreign public vessel visits to harbors that are not ports of entry.

subfiles.title: Consular report on HAKUYO MARU’s planned cruise
subfiles.from: Arthur Garrels, American Consulate General, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Reports proposed calls at closed Alaskan ports and requests instructions on consular documents.
subfiles.summary: Garrels forwards the Institute’s letter and itinerary. He notes thirty days allotted to fishing and investigation in Bristol Bay and asks for a telegraphic decision on visas and the bill of health.

subfiles.title: Fishery Institute request for cruise documents
subfiles.about: Requests free certification of the HAKUYO MARU’s crew list and bill of health.
subfiles.summary: Sugiura describes training aims and planned study landings at St. Paul and Dutch Harbor.

subfiles.title: Fourteenth voyage schedule of HAKUYO MARU
subfiles.about: Lists ports and dates for the training ship’s 1937 Pacific and Bering Sea voyage.
subfiles.summary: The schedule assigns thirty days to fishing and investigation in Bristol Bay.

subfiles.title: Consular reply to Sugiura
subfiles.about: Explains that visits to closed Alaskan ports require diplomatic approval.
subfiles.summary: Consular documents can be issued without charge once authorization is received.

subfiles.title: HAKUYO MARU itinerary sent to Commerce
subfiles.about: Forwards Sugiura’s letter and voyage schedule to the Bureau of Fisheries.
subfiles.summary: The enclosures supplement the proposed Dutch Harbor visit.

subfiles.title: Initial consular notice limiting visit
subfiles.about: Advises that the HAKUYO MARU may visit Dutch Harbor only.
subfiles.summary: Replies to Garrels’s March 16 despatch.

subfiles.title: Internal distinction between Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Records agreement to distinguish seal protection vessel HAKUHO MARU from training ship HAKUYO MARU.
subfiles.summary: Bower and Commander Hill concurred in the proposed distinction.

subfiles.title: State’s proposed denial of HAKUYO MARU’s St. Paul call
subfiles.about: Seeks Navy’s view on denying the HAKUYO MARU permission to visit St. Paul.
subfiles.summary: State argues that the training ship’s proposed seal breeding study does not fall within the 1911 treaty, unlike a possible visit by the Japanese seal protection vessel. It also recounts a complaint about HAKUYO MARU officers boarding an American fishing vessel in 1934.

subfiles.title: Confidential HAKUYO MARU papers to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards State’s reply to Japan and the vessel’s detailed voyage schedule.
subfiles.summary: State highlights the thirty days planned for Bristol Bay fishing and investigation.

subfiles.title: Japanese explanation of St. Paul research
subfiles.about: Explains that the St. Paul call would study seal breeding and protection facilities.
subfiles.summary: Japan proposes comparing American practices with those in Japan.

subfiles.title: State’s initial decision on HAKUYO MARU cruise
subfiles.about: Rejects St. Paul and Bristol Bay access while approving Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: State cites hazardous Bristol Bay navigation and asks the vessel to stay out of territorial waters there. It holds that a training ship’s St. Paul study is outside the Fur Seals Treaty’s purpose. Dutch Harbor is approved for July 14–17 with customary facilities.

subfiles.title: HAKUHO MARU request for western Aleutian calls
subfiles.about: Requests calls at three Aleutian harbors to investigate fur seal migration.
subfiles.summary: The note gives proposed June and July calls at Chichagof Harbor, Constantine Harbor, and Nazan Bay, and invokes the 1911 Fur Seals Convention.

subfiles.title: Commerce consultation on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Seeks advice on the proposed HAKUHO MARU visits to western Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: State forwards the Japanese request and its treaty rationale.

subfiles.title: Interior consultation on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Seeks advice on the proposed HAKUHO MARU visits to western Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: State forwards Japan’s seal migration rationale.

subfiles.title: Navy consultation on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Seeks Navy’s view of HAKUHO MARU’s proposed western Aleutian calls.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese treaty based request is enclosed.

subfiles.title: Treasury consultation on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Seeks Treasury’s view of the proposed western Aleutian calls.
subfiles.summary: State summarizes Japan’s request for an exception to port restrictions.

subfiles.title: War consultation on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Seeks War Department advice on the proposed western Aleutian calls.
subfiles.summary: The request concerns investigation of seal migration.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of HAKUHO MARU request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the requested HAKUHO MARU calls pending departmental consultation.
subfiles.summary: State promises an early substantive reply.

subfiles.title: State’s denial of western Aleutian calls
subfiles.about: Withholds permission for HAKUHO MARU to enter three western Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: State finds no evidence that the harbors lie on fur seal migration routes or fall within the treaty’s intended research access. It offers to reconsider if future American investigation establishes that seals visit them.

subfiles.title: Navy concurrence in St. Paul denial
subfiles.about: Agrees with State’s proposed refusal of HAKUYO MARU’s St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: Navy reports complete agreement with the proposed reply.

subfiles.title: Navy advice on HAKUYO MARU’s cruise
subfiles.about: Approves Dutch Harbor but advises against Bristol Bay territorial waters.
subfiles.summary: Navy cites the absence of ports of entry and dangerous navigation in Bristol Bay.

subfiles.title: Commerce assessment of Japanese vessel requests
subfiles.about: Assesses seal research claims and diplomatic consequences of refusing Japanese vessel calls.
subfiles.summary: Commerce finds no evidence of fur seals at the three requested western Aleutian harbors, but urges care because Japan could seek to alter the advantageous 1911 treaty. It recounts earlier Japanese visits and suggests allowing one vessel to visit the Pribilofs. It also notes concern over Japanese fishing near Alaska.

subfiles.title: Navy opposition to HAKUHO MARU harbor visits
subfiles.about: Recommends denying HAKUHO MARU access to three Aleutian harbors.
subfiles.summary: Navy cites dangerous, unlisted harbors and a lack of seal breeding grounds or major migration routes.

subfiles.title: Interior opposition to HAKUHO MARU harbor visits
subfiles.about: Finds insufficient grounds to permit the proposed seal migration study calls.
subfiles.summary: Interior sees neither useful migration data nor a treaty right to enter the listed harbors.

subfiles.title: Interior arrangements for Dutch Harbor
subfiles.about: Reports arrangements for HAKUYO MARU’s expected Dutch Harbor visit.
subfiles.summary: The Governor of Alaska was told to make available facilities under his control.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Dutch Harbor
subfiles.about: Explains War Department jurisdiction regarding HAKUYO MARU’s Dutch Harbor visit.
subfiles.summary: War has no Aleutian jurisdiction but informs its Ninth Corps Area commander.

subfiles.title: War Department opposition to HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Recommends denying HAKUHO MARU’s proposed western Aleutian visits.
subfiles.summary: War cites closed, hazardous harbors outside known seal breeding or migration areas.

subfiles.title: Customs authorization for Dutch Harbor
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s Dutch Harbor call.
subfiles.summary: The collector at Juneau is being instructed accordingly.

subfiles.title: Telephone note on St. Paul approval
subfiles.about: Confirms Navy has no objection to HAKUYO MARU visiting St. Paul Island.
subfiles.summary: Commander Hustvedt confirmed the position while covering Commander Hill’s duties.

subfiles.title: Request for departmental notifications
subfiles.about: Requests notices to the departments concerned with the revised decision.
subfiles.summary: An internal instruction to issue necessary notifications.

subfiles.title: Renewed Japanese request for St. Paul visit
subfiles.about: Asks the United States to reconsider HAKUYO MARU’s St. Paul visit.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador explains that the Institute is linked to Japan’s Agriculture and Forestry Department and trains graduates who may carry out fur seal treaty duties. Students seek to observe breeding conditions and protection facilities.

subfiles.title: Consular notice of St. Paul permission
subfiles.about: Advises that HAKUYO MARU may visit St. Paul as well as Dutch Harbor.
subfiles.summary: Revises the earlier Dutch Harbor only instruction.

subfiles.title: Agriculture notice of revised permission
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s newly approved St. Paul visit.
subfiles.summary: The notice supplements the earlier Dutch Harbor request.

subfiles.title: Commerce informed of St. Paul reconsideration
subfiles.about: Reports State’s decision to allow HAKUYO MARU to visit St. Paul.
subfiles.summary: State cites Japan’s fuller explanation, Commerce’s suggestion, and interdepartmental discussions. The permission is expressly not a precedent.

subfiles.title: Interior notice of revised permission
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s approved St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: The notice supplements the Dutch Harbor arrangements.

subfiles.title: Navy informed of St. Paul reconsideration
subfiles.about: Explains the reversal of State’s proposed refusal of HAKUYO MARU’s St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: State cites Japan’s further explanation, Commerce’s advice, and a May 19 interdepartmental conversation. The ambassador will be told the approval creates no precedent.

subfiles.title: Treasury notice of revised permission
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s approved St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: The planned visit is July 12–13.

subfiles.title: War notice of revised permission
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s approved St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: The notice supplements the earlier Dutch Harbor request.

subfiles.title: Labor notice of revised permission
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for HAKUYO MARU’s approved St. Paul call.
subfiles.summary: The planned visit is July 12–13.

subfiles.title: Embassy briefing on Japanese vessel visits
subfiles.about: Sends copies of notes and interdepartmental letters on Japanese vessels in Alaskan waters.
subfiles.summary: An informational transmittal to the embassy.

subfiles.title: Final consent for HAKUYO MARU at St. Paul
subfiles.about: Grants HAKUYO MARU a July 12–13 St. Paul visit.
subfiles.summary: Customary facilities will be provided; the consent is not a precedent.

subfiles.title: Immigration notice for Dutch Harbor visit
subfiles.about: Reports immigration officials’ notification of HAKUYO MARU’s Dutch Harbor visit.
subfiles.summary: The service is advising its Seattle representative.

subfiles.title: Consular telegram on amended ship documents
subfiles.about: Suggests telegraphing St. Paul authority to accept amended HAKUYO MARU documents.
subfiles.summary: The ship had already left Japanese waters when St. Paul permission arrived.

subfiles.title: Treasury’s conditional response on HAKUHO MARU
subfiles.about: Offers customs courtesies if other departments approve HAKUHO MARU’s Aleutian calls.
subfiles.summary: Treasury would instruct the Juneau collector upon notice of approval.

subfiles.title: Commerce waiver for HAKUYO MARU at Dutch Harbor
subfiles.about: Waives entry, clearance, fees, and tonnage tax for the Dutch Harbor call.
subfiles.summary: The Juneau customs collector is being notified.
